notes.title: Version 2.03 The Bathtub Fix
notes.notes: You can no longer get stuck in the bathtub.

notes.title: Patch Version 2.02
notes.notes: Changes the timing/trigger method of some jump scares to prevent them from being missed, removes some that just don't fit or overbear the game.

notes.title: Patch v2.01
notes.notes: Patches an issue causing the lighter to become unable to be used.  Fixed objects that are not meant to be interacted with.  Deleted a development save that could be loaded causing bugs at the end of the game.  Fixed some grammatical errors.

notes.title: Update Version 2.00
notes.notes: This update fixes a few subtitle bugs but mostly adds detail to environments in the last half of the game as well as several new scares.

notes.title: Version 1.20 Fixes Achievements
notes.notes:
Version 1.20 the latest update will correct any achievement issues.  If you have collected all the Vatican Coins and have completed the game, simply start a new "Play" and the achievements should be granted to you immediately.  Unfortunately, since there is no stat saving for just completing the game, you will have to play through the game to get this achievement unlocked if you did not get all the Vatican Coins on your first playthrough.  I apologize for this inconvenience. 

Stay tuned for Version 2.0 which will include new encounters, more lore updates and a shift in the environments explored and puzzles solved in a few weeks.  Overall, will be a big improvement to the current version which I believe I fell short in some respects that will be corrected.

notes.title: Version 1.12 Achievement Patch
notes.notes: This patch should fix the issue of unlocking achievements as well as a few quality-of-life fixes.  If users still notice an error with achievements/stats, please let me know so I can continue to find a solution.

notes.title: Version 1.1 is avaliable
notes.notes: The collision bug is patched, and game can be played without interruption.

notes.notes: Collision bug is now fixed, and game can be played without interruption.
